test_title: PYST 40: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 13 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.**

She tells me that I am her lucky charm.

options.text: She says to me, "You was my lucky charm."
She said to me, "You are my lucky charm."
She says to me, "I am your lucky charm."
She says to me, "You are my lucky charm."

solution:
The correct answer is **She says to me, "You are my lucky charm."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The given sentence is in Indirect Speech. As per the question we have to change it to Direct Speech. 
 
• In the given sentence, the reporting verb is in the present tense.
 
• So, the **tense** of the** reported speech **will remain the same.
 
• We change the tense and pronouns of reported speech only when reporting verb is in the past tense.
 
• In the given sentence 'I' will be changed into 'You' because in **'direct to indirect'** speech the first-person pronouns are changed according to the subject of the reporting verb.
 
• While changing the given Indirect narration into Direct narration,** commas, and inverted commas** will be added, and connector 'that' will be removed.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *She says to me, "You are my lucky charm."*
